```plato
	// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypotrochoid
	// x = (R-r)cos t + d cos((R-r)/r t); y = (R-r)sin t - d sin((R-r)/r t)
	Hypotrochoid(t: Angle, R: Number, r: Number, d: Number): Point2D
		=> ((R - r) * t.Cos + d * ((R - r) / r * t).Cos,
			(R - r) * t.Sin - d * ((R - r) / r * t).Sin);
```
